moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio pt-snow, written here): 50 flakes with a seeded depth d 0.4-1: fall speed 55 x d px / s (on a 220 px frame: far ~4 s, near ~2 s per fall), radius 1 + 3 d px, sway 10 x d px on sin(1.5 t + i); near flakes (d > 0.8) in the accent, others grey; linear, wrapped for a seamless loop. Params: count (50) · fall (2–4 s) · sway (10 px) · seed.
